dict.string: Cadence reads your steps, workouts, and heart rate so your activity and Watch-recorded sessions appear here. Your health data never leaves your device.
Cadence saves a summary of your strength workouts to Apple Health so they appear system-wide and close your Activity rings.
Cadence connects to a Bluetooth chest strap to record accurate heart rate during workouts.
Cadence uses your location to map and measure outdoor runs and rides recorded on your iPhone.
Cadence uses motion data to better recognize the kind of workout you are doing.
